headline: Saudi Arabia plans AI assistant for every citizen to simplify government services
label: NEWS
caption:
Saudi Arabia is planning to introduce an AI assistant for every citizen to simplify access to government services, according to Gulf News. 🤖

The initiative aims to make interacting with state departments much easier for the population through advanced technology.

Further details on the timeline and implementation of the AI project have not yet been fully detailed by authorities.

How would you use an official government AI assistant in your daily life? 👇
